name: Optisweep Service Restart
description: Restart the OptiSweep Windows service on the primary host when it stops responding to WCS API calls or tipper/OPC heartbeats go flat.
when_to_use: Tippers stop getting heartbeats and Ignition/OPC is not the cause on its own (training_video_day2).

After an Ignition gateway restart, GetAgvStatuses in Apidog still returns no response (case_228086, event_028) — restart OptiSweep next, then re-confirm with another API request before releasing an E-stop.
not_for: First response to an Ignition-only symptom (try capability:ignition_restart first; only restart OptiSweep if the API still does not respond afterward).

role_paths.guidance: Restart the OptiSweep service via Services MMC after confirming Ignition/OPC and API checks do not resolve the symptom; re-run GetAgvStatuses to confirm recovery before any E-stop release.
Same as L2; owns repeated/unplanned-restart RCA if the service keeps crashing.

healthy: OptiSweep service Running in Services MMC after restart
GetAgvStatuses returns a timely response post-restart
degraded: GetAgvStatuses still unresponsive after an Ignition gateway restart
escalate: Service continues to crash or fail to respond after restart — L3/L4, treat as a repeated unplanned-restart pattern

name: Ignition Restart
description: Restart the Ignition gateway (via gwcmd -r from the Ignition install directory, or the host restart path) when tipper/OPC heartbeats go flat or the gateway is suspected crashed.
when_to_use: Tipper heartbeats are flatlined and OPC/Ignition itself is suspected (training_video_day2).
Site reports Ignition may have crashed and needs verifying/restarting (case_228086, events 009/012).
Confirmed unresponsive gateway: run gwcmd -r from the Ignition install directory, then wait for 'Waiting for Gateway restart...' to complete (case_228086, events 018/022).
not_for: A symptom already isolated to the OptiSweep service or WCS API alone (use capability:optisweep_service_restart or capability:confirm_wcs_api_responsiveness first).

role_paths.guidance: Confirm gateway unresponsive first (performance page, OPC connections); restart via gwcmd -r from the Ignition install directory, then verify OptiSweep is still responding with GetAgvStatuses in Apidog before releasing any E-stop.
Same as L2; owns RCA if the gateway keeps crashing or the restart does not clear the symptom.

healthy: Gateway reachable and performance page normal after restart
GetAgvStatuses returns a timely response post-restart
degraded: Gateway restart still in progress ('Waiting for Gateway restart...') or gateway unreachable
escalate: GetAgvStatuses still unresponsive after the restart completes — escalate to capability:optisweep_service_restart, then L3/L4 if neither resolves it

name: Rms Map Reposition
description: Manually reposition an idle (green-state) AGV on the RMS map via the Go-to function — select a target by code or by clicking a cell on the map, then confirm the move.
when_to_use: An AGV is in a green (ready) state with no current task and needs to be moved to a specific location on the map (training_video_day1, AVEVA HMI Go-to function).
not_for: An AGV that is not in a green/ready state (use capability:recover_agv_physically or capability:confirm_agv_active_error_state first — this is a manual positioning action, not a fault-recovery step).

role_paths.guidance: Confirm the AGV is green/idle before using Go-to; select the target by code or by clicking the destination cell on the RMS map and confirm the move.
Same as L2; owns repeated/persistent repositioning needs (e.g. recurring map drift).

healthy: AGV is green/ready before the move and arrives at the confirmed target cell
degraded: AGV not in a green/ready state when reposition is attempted
Move does not complete or AGV does not reach the confirmed target
escalate: Reposition consistently fails or the AGV is not green/ready — treat as a fault symptom, escalate to capability:recover_agv_physically or capability:confirm_agv_active_error_state
